baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books. Android retains schema 17 and the desktop archive format; update the same application with its retained signing key and preserve complete exported copies with separate keys for rollback. Newer schemas are refused before unsupported presets without changing the library.
backup-recovery.note: Drafting tools preserve the existing transfer and recovery contracts; compatibility guidance adds the data used by the new mobile dialogs.

editor.note: Android drafting dialogs reuse outline presentation, save admission, scene search selections and existing book data with EN/DE strings.

encryption.note: Drafting tools do not change encryption; the updated compatibility guide retains the existing complete archive and separate-key contract.

maintenance.note: Android drafting now exposes scene mutations, search, goals, synopsis, references and comment resolution with documented privacy boundaries.

native-packaging.note: Android appearance preferences gain persistent text size; stacked transfer-branch PRs run the existing CI and package checks.
